specName: Landing copy pass and still hero tab buttons
request:
Issue #1027: Investigate: 2 ideas from the Watch Later review (landing copy pass + stop the hero tab buttons drifting). The PR body must carry `Closes #1027`.

Owner's decisions (settled, do not re-ask):
- The H1 "Spec-driven development, one level up." stays unchanged.
- Rewrite the four-fragment ownership line at apps/website/src/pages/index.astro:603 ("Your specs. Your pipeline. Your record. Your repo.") into one plain sentence a visitor reads as a fact, e.g. that specs, pipeline and run record stay as files in their own repo.
- Remove the em dash from the Understand tab body (line 207, "...what it decided against — with a coverage table...") by rewriting the sentence, not swapping punctuation.
- Rewrite the two headings that use an "X, not Y" frame: line 227 'The workflow is yours, not the tool’s' and line 236 'Say it in the margin, not in the chat box'. Keep each heading's meaning, drop the contrast frame. Leave body copy at lines 599 and 1049 and the CTA heading at 1062 alone. Respect the comment at lines 193-199 (three tab phrasings are deliberate; do not touch those).
- Stop the hero tab buttons (.hero-pip, ~line 1397) from drifting: remove the mote-drift animation from .hero-pip only. .mote and .spore keep their drift. The pips stay still (no replacement animation); keep any existing hover/focus styles. Update the comment at ~1372 that says the drift is deliberate.

Scope: apps/website only. Site changes get no changelog line (CLAUDE.md). Follow the writing rules: plain, human sentences, no em dashes, no "not X, it's Y" frames, no fragment runs. Verify with the site build (`npm run build` in apps/website or the repo's site build script) and any site tests. This is a visual change: the PR waits for the owner's review, do not merge.
